# Constrained Mixed Moco and Independent Native Replay

This provisional F07 calculation documents the combined path exercised by
child #12173 under #11791 and #11784. It composes the separately declared
OpenSim cold-start/constraint policy with the explicit mixed-muscle and
mechanical-assistance profile, then exports the solved inputs to T01 and
executes them on a fresh native model. It does not alter the strict default
muscle-only path or qualify production anatomy, physiology, contact, capture
matching, or release.

## Declared Native Constraints and Cold Start

`DeclaredColdStart` records the source identity, complete named continuous
state, initial time, every explicit coordinate lock target, expected native
constraint-enforcement map, residual tolerance, coordinate chart intervals,
and optional linear chart inequalities. The declaration does not disable,
remove, simplify, or silently re-target a native constraint. The constrained
path is opt-in; without a declaration, the existing strict muscle-only and
mixed-actuation admissions retain their prior restrictions.

The maintained Moco preparation checks every caller optimizer coordinate box
against its declared chart. For a linear chart rule
$\ell \leq \sum_i a_i q_i \leq h$, it computes the minimum and maximum of
each weighted independent interval and sums those extrema. The resulting
interval must lie inside $[\ell,h]$; unknown coordinates, overflow, and any
box that extends outside the chart block preparation. This is a conservative
box-containment proof, not a proof about arbitrary solver iterates outside the
declared box or every internal integrator stage.

Fresh reconstruction applies only the declared lock targets, restores the
named continuous state, fixes its declared clock, and reads back constraint
enforcement and residual observations. The one native `Manager` used by the
replay must initialize without changing any requested named state value or
the initial time. Any projection or other seed change raises before sampled
replay output is accepted. At each replay knot, the provider checks exact
native time, source chart membership, declared linear inequalities, native
constraint enforcement and position/velocity residuals. Observation is
read-only; it does not repair the state or alter saved controls.

## Mixed Physical Roles and Units

The ordered `MixedActuationProfile` covers every registered native scalar
actuator and binds its absolute path, role, finite control bounds, concrete
native law, coordinate association, native bounds, scale, and output unit.
Muscle channels keep dimensionless excitation separate from their nonlinear
native force in newtons. A `CoordinateActuator` command is also dimensionless;
native optimal force scales it into newtons for a translational coordinate or
newton-metres for a rotational coordinate. Mechanical assistance is labeled
as `root-residual`, `upper-assistance`, or `leg-reserve` by explicit profile
declaration; root assignment is checked against the actual ground-parent
topology, not the actuator name. These labels do not establish that a source
model contains clinically or biomechanically valid assistance.

T01 export retains the exact ordered control knots and binds model, complete
declared state, profile and execution-policy identity. Replay reloads that
immutable bundle, rejects changed declarations, reconstructs a fresh source
model, and sends only the saved time-indexed input. It records applied
dimensionless controls separately from physical actuator outputs, units,
power and sampled work. Results are immutable arrays. Every constrained mixed
sample also carries its native constraint observation digest and separate
maximum position and velocity residuals; no mixed-unit global residual norm is
used.

## Native Fixture Evidence

The direct changed-future replay fixture contains two Millard muscles, a
relative rotational Pin coordinate, and an explicit linear coordinate
coupler. Four sampled times span 15 ms. Its 0.2 coordinate command at an
optimal-force scale of 7 produces 1.4 N*m, retained separately from the 0.2
input. The test also checks read-only per-sample enforcement, residuals no
greater than the fixture's declared $10^{-9}$ tolerance, and a byte-identical
common prefix before a changed future assistance command. The maintained
40 ms synthetic Moco fixture contains two muscles, a ground-parented
translational Slider, a relative rotational Pin and a declared coupler. It
exports solver knots and independently replays simultaneous muscle and
mechanical commands through the combined path.

Four negative regressions perturb a dependent coordinate's requested initial
value or speed by $5\times10^{-10}$ in both the mixed replay and mechanical
prepared-state paths, verifying that native `Manager` initialization cannot
hide the altered seed by projection. Other checks reject
an omitted constraint declaration, changed declaration policy, competing
command/controller policy, optimizer bounds outside the chart, and a linear
chart whose interval proof fails.

These short synthetic runs establish bounded software-path behavior only.
They are not private swing captures, static-equilibrium demonstrations,
source-model preparation, or physiology/contact acceptance. A finite solve,
low fixture marker error, fresh replay, or passing software tests does not
convert the T01 profile into a production model qualification.

## Reproduction and Remaining Gates

Use the already-installed OpenSim 4.6 Python 3.12 runtime and its matching
CasADi configuration; no new environment is required. The focused frozen
regression completed with 73 passed and one explicit unavailable-provider
skip in 63.60 seconds. The separate successful Moco v2 run used a 40 ms
synthetic target, marker weight $10^4$, and completed in 20.49 seconds. The
prior hidden-projection/seed regression is retained as RED evidence; it is not
included as a production failure. The central manual still has zero
registered calculations and `blocked-inventory-required` status.

The disjoint existing pure-muscle/contact and Moco-runner regression completed
with 124 passed and two explicit skips in 66.39 seconds. Across the combined
selected regressions this is 197 passed and three skips; no test is counted
twice.

Before any production interpretation, the source needs reviewed native
anatomy, calibrated marker attachments, a validated complete state, passive
force policy, model-specific assistance mapping, contact/grip policy, and
independent full-horizon replay. Private capture fit, all required variants,
six-engine parity, physiology and manual release approval remain open.
